provenance: team-made Full Tag label documents (full-tag-labels/v1); no video and no real people: the clip names are placeholders and the players are slots only
method: QD-AN-03 hand count from docs/domain/pattern-catalogue.md v0.1 (sections 0-5), tallied rally by rally from the rally sheet (`sheet`) by the coach; checked against the coach's replay docs/domain/tools/pattern_example.py --check, which imports neither the product nor scripts/measure/ (ADR 0044). Court frame as catalogue section 0.7 (UNVERIFIED until P7).

buckets.AN-09: mix: third shots counted per trajectory (drop = k, all = n); excluded: rally ids per reason
buckets.AN-13: samples: rally id -> x (the side's dinks in the run minus the erring one); censored: the side's other dink rallies; excluded: rally ids per reason
buckets.AN-08: returns by the side: deep (k), not_deep (n - k); excluded: rally ids per reason
buckets.unassigned: match-level rallies of neither side, per reason
